roman_tribal_army.armyName: Roman Tribal Army - 753 BC to c.550 BC

units.name: Cavalry
units.description: Tribal cavalry have spear and shield. The unit may not comprise more than 3 bases.

units.name: Noble Infantry
units.description: Noble Infantry have spear and large shield. Open Order. May be Superior fighters (+4) and have light armour (+2).

units.name: Tribal Infantry
units.description: Tribal Infantry have spear and large shield. Open Order. May be fielded as Skirmishers at a cost of 7 points per base

units.name: Skirmishers
units.description: Skirmishers have javelins. Skirmishers

roman_state_army.armyName: Roman State Army - c.550 BC to c.360 BC

units.name: King, Dictator or Consul
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Clan Chief or Military Tribune
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Equites
units.description: Equites have light armour, spear and shield. Max 5 bases, may not be fielded with Dismounted Equites.

units.name: Equites
units.description: Dismounted Equites have light armour, spear and large shield. Open Order. Riding horses. May be upgraded to Superior fighters (+4). Max 5 bases, may not be fielded with Equites.

units.name: Principes
units.description: Principes have light armour, spear and large shield. Open Order. May be upgraded to Superior fighters (+4).

units.name: Hsatati
units.description: Hastati have spear and large shield. Open Order. May downgrade to Shield (D6) at -2 points per base. May be fielded as Skirmishers at a cost of 7 points per base (6 points if D6).

units.name: Leves
units.description: Leves have javelins. Skirmishers

the_aequi_and_volsci.armyName: The Aequi and Volsci c.550 BC to 340 BC

units.name: Cavalry
units.description: Tribal Cavalry have light armour, spear and shield. The unit may not comprise more than four bases

units.name: Tribal Infantry
units.description: Tribal Infantry have large shield and javelins. Open Order. Up to three units may have light armour (+2). One unit may be Superior fighters (+4). Troops without upgrades may be fielded as Skirmishers at a cost of 7 points per base.

units.name: Skirmishers
units.description: Skirmishers have javelins. Skirmishers

senones_insubres_and_boii.armyName: Senones , Insubres and Boii 600 BC to 220 BC

units.name: High Chieftain
units.description: May Ride a Horse, or a chariot.

units.name: Chieftain
units.description: May Ride a Horse, or a chariot

units.name: Minor Chieftain
units.description: May Ride a Horse, or a chariot

units.name: Cavalry
units.description: Tribal Cavalry have light armour, spear and shield. The unit may not comprise more than four bases

units.name: Noble Cavalry
units.description: Noble Cavalry have spear, shield, and light armour. Superior fighters.

units.name: Noble Chariots
units.description: Noble Chariots have an unarmed driver and one warrior crewman with javelins, light armour, and shield. Light Chariots. Superior fighters.

units.name: Light Cavalry
units.description: Light Cavalry have spear and shield.

units.name: Warband
units.description: Warband have throwing spear and shield. WArband. Up to half the bases may have light armour (+2).

units.name: Warriors
units.description: Warriors have throwing spear and shield. Up to half the bases may have light armour (+2).

units.name: Gaesati
units.description: Gaesati have throwing spear and shield. Stubborn.

units.name: Fanatics
units.description: Fanatics have throwing spear and shield. Warband. Stubborn

units.name: Skirmishers
units.description: Javelins and shield. May exchange javelins for sling or bow (free). There may not be more bow units than sling units, and sling or bow units may not be larger than the smallest javelin unit in the army; there must be at least one javelin unit.

categories.name: Allies
categories.description: May have allied contingents from the Etruscan and Gallic lists, both at once if desired.

units.name: General
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Commander
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Warriors
units.description: Warriors have javelins and shield. May have spears (+1) and light armour (+1).

units.name: Extraordinarii
units.description: Extraordinarii have throwing spear, light armour and large shield. Superior fighters. Open Order. May have javelins (+2) and be Drilled (+3).

units.name: Tribesmen
units.description: Tribesmen have throwing spear and large shield. Open Order. May have light armour (+2) and javelins (+2).

units.name: Skirmishers
units.description: Skirmishers have javelins and shield. Inferior fighters. Skirmishers.

early_republican_legionary_army.armyName: Early Republican Legionary Army - c.360 BC to c.210 BC

categories.name: Allies
categories.description: The army may have allied contingents from the Italian Hill Tribes, Campanian, Gallic, or Magna Graecia lists

units.name: Consul
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Dictator
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Tribune
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Roman Equites and Latin Horse
units.description: Roman Equites and Latin Horse have light armour, spear and shield. May have javelins (+1). Units should not be more than four bases strong.

units.name: Hastati
units.description: Hastati have spear and large shield. They may have light armour (+2) and may be Drilled (+3). At an unknown point early in the period, they exchanged spear for heavy throwing spear (+4). There must be one unit of Hastati for each unit of Principes in the army.

units.name: Principes
units.description: Principes have light armour, spear, and large shield. They may be Drilled (+3) and Stubborn (+2). From the end of the  war against Pyrrhos, they replace spear with heavy throwing spear (+4). There must be one unit of Principes for every unit of Triarii in the army.

units.name: Triarii
units.description: Triarii have light armour, spear, and large shield. Drilled. May be Superior fighters (+4) and Stubborn (+2).

units.name: Rorarii
units.description: Rorarii have javelins and spear. Inferior fighters. Skirmishers. These units are used until the end of the war against Pyrrhos.

units.name: Leves
units.description: Leves have javelins and shield. Inferior fighters. Skirmishers. There must be one base of Leves for every three bases of Hastati in the army. These troops should be used in armies after the war against Pyrrhos.

units.name: Extraordinarii
units.description: Extraordinarii have throwing spear and shield. Superior fighters. Open Order. They may have light armour (+2) and large shield (+2). The Extraordinarii unit may not be larger than any of the Italian spearmen units, and cannot be used if there are none of these present

units.name: Italian Spearmen
units.description: Italian Spearmen have a throwing spear and shield. Open Order. May have large shield (+2).

units.name: Leves
units.description: Skirmishers have javelins and shield. Inferior fighters. Skirmishers.

units.name: Heavy Cavalry
units.description: Heavy Cavalry have javelins. May have light armour (+1). One unit may upgrade to C8, Superior fighters, (+4) as Elite troops.

units.name: Light Cavalry
units.description: Light Cavalry have javelins. Skirmishers. Inferior fighters.

units.name: Tarentines
units.description: Tarentines have javelins and large shield. Skirmishers. Inferior fighters. Parthian Shot.

units.name: Regular Hoplites
units.description: Regular Hoplites have spear and large shield. Phalanx.  May take light armour (+2) or heavy armour (+4).

units.name: Mercenary Hoplites
units.description: Mercenary Hoplites have spear and large shield. Phalanx. May take light armour (+2) or heavy armour (+4). May upgrade to Trained Phalanx (+2) and may be Veteran (+1). One unit may upgrade to Superior fighters, Trained Phalanx, Veteran (+7) as elite troops.

units.name: Militia Hoplites
units.description: Militia Hoplites have spear and large shield. Inferior fighters. Phalanx. Levy.

units.name: Peltasts
units.description: Peltasts have javelins and shield. Open Order. May be fielded as Skirmishers at a cost of 7 points per base.

units.name: Rhodians
units.description: Rhodians have sling and shield. Skirmishers.

units.name: Cretans
units.description: Cretans have bow and shield. Superior Shooters. Skirmishers. The unit should not be more than four bases strong.

units.name: Mercenary Skirmishers
units.description: Mercenary Skirmishers have javelins and shield. Inferior fighters. Skirmishers.

units.description: Skirmishers have javelins. Inferior fighters. Skirmishers.

units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Hipparch
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Agema
units.description: Agema have light armour and spear. Superior Fighters. Wedge. Stubborn. Used to Elephants. They may have heavy armour (+1). May be Veteran (+1).

units.name: Thessalians
units.description: Thessalians have light armour, spear and javelins. Superior Fighters. Superior Shooters. Wedge. Used to Elephants. They may have heavy armour (+1). May be Veteran (+1).

units.name: Macedonian and Epirot Cavalry
units.description: Macedonian and Epirot Cavalry have light armour and spear.  Superior Fighters. Wedge. Used to Elephants. They may have heavy armour (+1).May be Veteran (+1).

units.name: Mercenary Horse
units.description: Mercenary Horse have javelins. Inferior Fighters. Used to Elephants. May have shield (+1). May be ﬁelded as Skirmishers.

units.name: Macedonian Phalanx
units.description: Macedonians have pike, light armour and shield. Trained Phalanx. May be Veteran (+1)

units.name: Epirote and Mercenary Phalanx
units.description: Epirotes have pike, light armour and shield. Trained Phalanx. May be Veteran (+1).

units.name: Aetolian Peltasts

units.name: Cretan Archers
units.description: Cretan Archers have bow and shield. Skirmishers. Superior Shooters.

units.name: Italian Skirmishers
units.description: Italian Skirmishers have javelins and shield. Skirmishers. Inferior Fighters. Inferior Shooters.

units.name: Rhodian Slingers
units.description: Rhodian slingers have sling and shield. Skirmishers. Inferior Fighters. This unit must be the smallest skirmish unit in the army.

units.name: Retrained Tarentines
units.description: Retrained Tarentines have light armour, pike and shield. Trained Phalanx.

units.name: Tarentine Cavalry
units.description: Tarentines have javelins and large shield. Skirmishers. Inferior Fighters. Parthian Shot.

units.description: Unarmed Mahout; the two crew have light armour, javelins, and shields hung on the outside of the elephant’s howdah. Superior Fighters. The elephants may benefit from the Escorts rule.

units.name: Greek Peltasts

units.description: Sikel Skirmishers have javelins. Inferior Fighters. Skirmishers. May replace javelins with bow or sling (free).

units.name: Spanish Infantry
units.description: Spanish Infantry have javelins and shield. Open Order. Warband. They may have light armour (+2) and throwing spears (+2).

units.name: Sardinians
units.description: Sardinians have javelins and shield. Warband

units.name: Celts
units.description: Celt infantry have throwing spear and shield. Warband. May be fielded in Open Order at a cost of 11 points per base. May take light armour (+2).

units.name: Ligurians
units.description: Ligurian infantry have throwing spear and shield. Warband. May be fielded in Open Order at a cost of 11 points per base. May may have javelins (+2).

units.name: African Elephant
units.description: Unarmed Mahout and two crew with javelins. A third crewman may be added (+4). All crew may have light armour (+1). The elephant may be ﬁ tted with a howdah (+4), which provides a D of 5+. The elephants may beneﬁ t from the Escorts rule.

units.name: Hannibal
units.description: May ride a horse. May have the Stratagem rule (+50)

units.name: Sub General
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Punic Cavalry
units.description: Punic Cavalry have spear and shield. May have light armour (+1).

units.name: Spanish Cavalry

units.name: Gallic Cavalry
units.description: Gallic Cavalry have spear and shield. Superior Fighters. May have Light Armour (+1) and javelins (+1).

units.name: Numidian Cavalry
units.description: Numidian Cavalry have javelins and shield. Inferior Fighters. Superior Shooters. Evade. Numidians may be fielded as  Skirmishers with Parthian Shot (loose Evade).

units.name: African Spearmen
units.description: African spearmen have light armour, large shield and spear.

units.name: Scutarii
units.description: Scutarii have throwing spear and shield. Evade. May have light armour (+2). May upgrade to large shield (+2) and/or heavy throwing spear (+1), but lose Evade if they do the latter.

units.name: Gauls
units.description: Gauls have throwing spear and shield. Warband. May have light armour (+2) and large shield (+2).

units.name: Caetrati
units.description: Caetrati have javelins and shield. Skirmishers.

units.name: Gallic or Numidian Javelinmen
units.description: Javelinmen have javelins and shield. Inferior Fighters.  Skirmishers.

units.name: Gallic or Iberian Slingers
units.description: Gallic or Iberian slingers have sling and shield. Inferior Fighters. Skirmishers.

units.name: Balearic Slingers
units.description: Balearic Slingers are Superior Shooters. Have Sling and Shield. Skirmishers. A Balearic unit must contain no more models than the other smallest slinger unit.

units.name: African Elephant
units.description: Unarmed Mahout and two crew with javelins. A third crewman may be added (+4). All crew may have light armour (+1). An elephant with two crew may be fitted with a howdah (+4), which provides a D of 5+. The elephants may benefit from the Escorts rule.
